key_insight: Seedance 2.0 introduces a unified, large-scale audio–video generation architecture that natively supports multi-modal conditioning (text, image, audio, video), enabling joint generation and comprehensive content reference/editing in a single model.
problem_solved: Bridges fragmented multimodal video generation workflows by providing a single, efficient model that accepts diverse inputs and performs joint audio–video synthesis and editing, reducing the need for separate specialized pipelines.
method: Unified, large-scale architecture for joint audio–video generation that handles four input modalities: text, image, audio, and video.
Highly efficient model design and training to scale multimodal generation while enabling integrated reference and editing capabilities.
End-to-end inference that combines conditional synthesis and multimodal content editing within one system (replacing piecemeal pipelines).
impact: Enables AI/ML practitioners to build more flexible, production-ready multimodal video workflows with fewer moving parts, accelerating research and content creation that requires synchronized audio and visual control.
visual_elements: Architecture diagram: show four input modalities funneling into a single joint audio–video generator and decoder.
Capability comparison chart: Seedance 1.0/1.5 Pro vs Seedance 2.0 (modalities supported, editing features, efficiency).
Example mosaic: side-by-side generated video clips demonstrating text->video, image-conditioned editing, and audio-driven motion.
Pipeline/UX flow: user inputs → multimodal conditioning → joint generation → editing/refinement
paper_title: Seedance 2.0: Advancing Video Generation for World Complexity
paper_authors: Team Seedance, De Chen, Liyang Chen, Xin Chen, Ying Chen
